nodes.label: Reel-Style Animation Bar (studywith.karen, rosacodes)
nodes.rationale: Hand-drawn seeded wobble, persona doodles, title card, margin notes, captions; avoid generic clip-art or PowerPoint fly-ins.

nodes.label: PDF Section Design Spec
nodes.rationale: For the Gnani hackathon demo: narration customisability and reel-quality animation are the product; upload/storage/layout only need to be solid.

nodes.label: Layout C: Shifts When You Ask
nodes.norm_label: layout c: shifts when you ask
nodes.rationale: PDF wide while reading, board wide once a question is asked; drag to override. Phones fall back to PDF on top, board below.

nodes.label: Free-Text Narration Style
nodes.rationale: Style changes tone, jokes and metaphors, never the facts; preset chips plus free text.

nodes.label: Per-PDF IndexedDB Lesson Storage
nodes.rationale: Replay must cost no Groq or Gnani calls, so script and audio blobs are stored per PDF hash in the browser.

nodes.label: Personas (teacher, gossip, coach, story)
nodes.rationale: Persona changes tone only, never facts; accuracy guardrail via second Evon pass.

nodes.norm_label: pdf layout mockup with animated board demo

nodes.label: Layout Settled: PDF Left, Board Right
nodes.norm_label: layout settled: pdf left, board right

nodes.label: Question Locating via Gemini Page Image
nodes.norm_label: question locating via gemini page image

nodes.label: Voice-Synced Reveals via `at` Phrase
nodes.rationale: Gnani returns no timing data, so character position of `at` in `say` scaled to clip length approximates word timing at zero extra calls; upgrade to per-phrase clips if drift is visible.

nodes.label: Uptodown APK (not Solvely)
nodes.rationale: Downloaded APK was Uptodown's store client; superseded by the genuine Solvely APK analysis.

nodes.label: Google Gemini Flash
nodes.rationale: Reads photos into text first because Evon is text-only.

nodes.label: Gnani Evon v3.3
nodes.rationale: Text-only solver model served via OpenAI-compatible endpoint; later swapped for Groq per commit history.

nodes.label: Board Script JSON Format
nodes.rationale: Everything the AI draws is data in this format; named palette only so the model never sends raw colors; 1000x700 virtual canvas.

nodes.label: Watch Mode (Silent Tutor)
nodes.rationale: Hard part is deciding when to speak; talking too often makes students turn it off, so check only after pauses with a minimum gap.

nodes.label: Proposed Architecture (Next.js + /api/solve)
nodes.rationale: One shared solver widget reused across tool pages; skip i18n, experiments, ads, writing tools for v1; auth/quota later via anonymous device ID + per-IP rate limit.
